purpose.source_body: Existing source collider in Godot XYZ metres; all detail levels remain inside it.
purpose.post_body: Existing compact Blue Delay collider. No saved placement or body changes.
purpose.port_height: Existing Blue signal endpoint at 1.18 m.
purpose.lod_triangles: Near/mid/far reduction targets; record achieved counts and inspect silhouette without waiving physical checks.
purpose.scar: 6 mm half-core, 22 mm damaged margin and up to 3 mm recess in the opaque slate. Cool blue light has no Frost or gameplay effect.
purpose.paths: Inspected Blender top XY/front XZ surface paths. Only selected compression fractures carry light.
purpose.period_seconds: Natural host lingers in one fracture, then moves onward over 4.5 seconds. The device uses actual native delay instead.
purpose.minimum_light: 25% ambient floor keeps the narrow natural scar visible between crests.
purpose.peak_emission: Peak 4.0, checked in both renderers with bloom disabled.
purpose.source_ready_gain: Subdued ready-source pulse, zero after exhaustion or during blocked reformation.
purpose.source_work_gain: Brighter after actual manual extraction progress, without inventing a work timer.
purpose.claim_gain: Quiet exposed-mineral light while native claim or carried count is positive.
purpose.camera_fov: 48-degree isolated review camera; not player-camera tuning.
purpose.release_seconds: 0.65 second passage only when a native pending request expires in an active tick; refusal still consumes that request. Cancel, rewire and reload do not trigger it.
